name: agent-router
description: Runs the Agent Router proxy on this machine, keeps it current, points Claude Code at it, and shows your quota in the status bar.

agentRouter.port.description: Port the router serves on. Claude Code is pointed at this port.

agentRouter.listenOnNetwork.description: Listen on every interface so the phone app can reach the router. Set a router password in the dashboard first; only other devices are ever asked for it.

agentRouter.manageService.description: Register the router as a login item (launchd on macOS, a systemd user unit on Linux) so it is up before any editor window is.

agentRouter.configureClaudeCode.description: Point Claude Code at the router (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL in ~/.claude/settings.json) and launch it through the router's wrapper (claudeCode.claudeProcessWrapper), which is what makes sessions followable from the phone.

agentRouter.showStatusBar.description: Show the 5-hour and 7-day quota in the status bar.
